name: io.github.epinethrone/icloud-mcp
title: iCloud
description: iCloud Mail, Calendar, Contacts, Reminders, Notes and Drive. Approval-first, self-hosted or local.

packageArguments.description: Run over stdio for a desktop client on this computer.

environmentVariables.name: ICLOUD_APP_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: An app-specific password from account.apple.com (not your Apple password).

environmentVariables.name: ICLOUD_DISPLAY_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Name shown on mail you send.

environmentVariables.name: DEFAULT_TIMEZONE
environmentVariables.description: IANA timezone for calendar times, e.g. Europe/Berlin.

environmentVariables.name: SEND_REQUIRES_APPROVAL
environmentVariables.description: true: mail Claude sends is saved to Drafts for you to send. false: sent directly.
